text: Right so I've been sitting here waiting on a callback for the best part of an hour now and nothing, so I'm going to type this out instead. I'm minding my nephew Cian tonight, he's 4, his mam and dad are away at a wedding down the country till tomorrow. He's grand in himself, now I'll say that straight off, eating away, giving me loads of cheek, the usual. But he has a few insect bites on him, two on the back of one leg and one on his arm, and he's driving himself demented scratching at them. They're itchy is all, he says they're 'stingy'. I've no idea what his mam normally puts on them and she's not answering the phone, which is typical. I didn't want to go rooting in their press and give him something I shouldn't. So what can I actually use on a 4 year old for itchy bites? And will you tell whoever's on the phone line that some of us have been waiting a fair while.
